description: Check whether a scene has finished building and get its link once it has. Use it after upload_scene returned 'compiling', or when the user asks if a scene is ready; poll every 10 to 30 seconds. For upload links use get_upload_link_status; to browse all scenes use list_scenes. Parameter: `scene` can be the job id from upload_scene, the scene id, or a Verse link the user pasted. Job ids resolve for 2 hours after upload; after that pass the scene id or link, which is looked up in the signed-in account. Read-only and free to call repeatedly. A failed build returns a plain message saying what to fix (for example an unsupported file inside a zip). Older scenes need sign-in; a build started in this session does not.

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

name: get_scene_status

arUrl.description: USDZ link for iPhone AR, products only.

link.description: Link that opens the scene in any browser.

message.description: Plain explanation of the failure and how to fix it.

title: Check a scene's build status
